## MCP - Language Detector

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/language-detector

**Description:** Detecte la langue d'un texte et retourne des informations detaillees.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["user_id", "guild_id", "user_request", "text"],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID utilisateur (credits, quotas)" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID serveur Discord" },
    "user_request": { "type": "string", "description": "Requete utilisateur originale" },
    "text": { "type": "string", "description": "Texte a analyser pour detection de langue" }
  }
}
```

**Note:** API keys fournies par le systeme.

**Returns:**
- `code`: ISO 639-1 language code (en, fr, es, de, zh, ja, ar, etc.)
- `name`: Full language name in English
- `confidence`: Detection confidence (0.0 to 1.0)
- `script`: Writing script (latin, cyrillic, arabic, han, etc.)
- `is_mixed`: Boolean if multiple languages detected
- `languages`: Array of detected languages if mixed

**Model:** gpt-4o-mini (fast, cost-effective)

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": false,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["code", "name", "confidence", "script"],
  "domain": "language"
}
```
